Such exceptions are unlikely to be resolved by retrying the same operation within this method and are better handled by a higher-level error handler or by terminating execution. Therefore, adding local exception handling for these runtime exceptions is not beneficial. The existing catch for LoginFailureException is appropriate for the intended retry logic.
